title: Elk Hunter's UFO Encounter Has Montana Hunters Looking to the Sky
site_name: The Missoula Current News - Daily News in Missoula Montana
excerpt: Imagine packing out an elk when a massive, silent, black triangle appears above the mountains. One hunter claims that's exactly what happened
content:
If you’ve hunted elk in Montana, you probably understand how remote and spooky the backcountry can feel. From the pitch-black timber to the unusual sounds and that weird feeling that someone is watching you, there’s enough going on to spark your imagination.

Imagine being in the middle of elk country when suddenly you look up and see a large black silent triangle flying between mountain peaks. That is what allegedly occurred to a Wyoming elk hunter more than twenty years ago. According to some recent information released by the government regarding a similar object, this man’s tale is receiving renewed interest.

An Unexpected Twist During a Wyoming Elk Hunt

Gary Medicine Cloud was hunting elk with his partner in Wyoming's Wind River Range in 2003, when his partner killed a bull elk. While Medicine Cloud was observing the surrounding woods (as well as ensuring there wasn’t a bear coming down looking for a free meal), Medicine Cloud claimed that he saw something much stranger.

Medicine Cloud said that he observed an extremely large black triangular object approximately 20-40 yards in length quietly maneuvering itself between the mountain peaks. Ultimately, the object turned sharply and ascended nearly straight up into the air before disappearing.

An elk hunter packs out elk from the mountains many times and has had concerns about bears, weather conditions, steep terrain, etc., but a flying Dorito would not have been one of my biggest worries.

Government UFO Files Described Similar Object

This story has gained new attention because of the release of government files detailing a different incident where U.S. federal agents encountered a black triangular-shaped object.

In their report, agents explained that they observed a significantly smaller version of the same black triangular-shaped object they previously mentioned, hovering above a ridgeline in the western U.S. In addition, according to the agents’ report, once the object began to accelerate, it quickly moved off without making any audible noise or releasing any type of smoke/exhaust.

Agents have yet to determine what either of these objects was. But, at this point in time, there is no data available that indicates whether or not the two incidents may have had any connection.

Regardless of its validity, it’s the type of story that grabs your attention. Especially if you have spent extended periods of time roaming the mountains during nighttime hours.

Montana Hunters Understand Why the Back Country Gets Weird

Like many others, I have spent countless hours hunting elk in the dark timber of Montana. As a result of my experiences within those types of environments, I too have experienced things that I could not provide explanations for. For example, during an archery elk hunt, I viewed what seemed to be a pink-glowing orb moving through the trees. Whatever the source was, I’m confident that it wasn’t a light from anyone’s headlamp or flashlight. Even though I attempted to identify why I saw what I did, I still cannot create an image to describe it.

Not saying it was a UFO. Saying that I still do not know what I saw.

And I suspect I am not alone as a Montana hunter experiencing something strange in our backcountry areas.

When you are many miles from any road, and you are completely surrounded by nothing but mountains and timber, you tend to observe things that you wouldn’t normally take note of. At times you will find logical answers to questions you raised while also other times leave yourself wondering.

I don’t think aliens are hanging out at elk camps in the Rockies. But if they’re searching for intelligent life, I suggest avoiding the wall tent after someone busts open a bottle of whiskey!

However, I am interested in hearing from other Montana hunters who have also experienced strange lights, unexplained aerial activity, or anything else creepy while hunting here.
